description: This file defines a class ArgillaLogger for logging and sending data to Argilla, including methods for validation, credential retrieval, message processing, batching, and asynchronous logging.

classes.name: ArgillaLogger
classes.description: A custom batch logger class for sending logs to Argilla, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous operations, with validation, batching, and credential management.

methods.name: is_serializable
methods.description: Checks if a value is serializable, excluding coroutine, function, generator types, and BaseModel.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes ArgillaLogger with API credentials, dataset info, URL, and sets up HTTP client, batching, and periodic flushing.

methods.name: validate_argilla_transformation_object
methods.description: Validates that the transformation object is a dictionary with values in supported payload fields.

methods.name: get_credentials_from_env
methods.description: Retrieves Argilla credentials and dataset info from parameters or environment variables, with validation and API call to verify dataset.

methods.name: get_chat_messages
methods.description: Extracts chat messages from payload, handling list or dict formats.

methods.name: get_str_response
methods.description: Extracts response string from payload, handling string or dict formats.

methods.name: _prepare_log_data
methods.description: Prepares a log data item for Argilla based on payload and transformation object.

methods.name: _send_batch
methods.description: Sends the current batch of logs to Argilla via POST request.

methods.name: log_success_event
methods.description: Handles successful event logging, including sampling, batching, and queue management.

methods.name: async_log_success_event
methods.description: Asynchronous version of log_success_event, with support for callback hooks.

methods.name: async_log_failure_event
methods.description: Asynchronous logging for failure events, with batching.

methods.name: async_send_batch
methods.description: Asynchronously sends the current batch of logs to Argilla via PUT request.
